description.zh-CN: 收起条上多一排并排立着的小电池：这台电脑和已连接的蓝牙设备各一个（最多 4 个），颜色各不相同，电量低的变黄、变红；不显示数字，鼠标悬停或点开页面看具体电量。岛上还有一个页面列出全部设备。读 Windows 已经知道的电量，AirPods 这类苹果耳机则听它们自己广播的电量（连着时每分钟听 5 秒，精确到 10%）；不连接设备、不需要管理员权限、不联网。插件一直运行，多一个 PowerShell 进程。
description.en: Adds a row of small upright batteries to the collapsed bar: one for this computer and one for each connected Bluetooth device (up to 4), each in its own color, yellow or red when low; no numbers there, hover or open the page for them. A page lists every device. Reads the levels Windows already knows, and for AirPods-like Apple earphones the levels they broadcast (5 seconds of listening each minute while connected, in steps of 10%); it connects to nothing, needs no administrator rights and never goes online. The plugin keeps running: one more PowerShell process.
